Review at head e81cf16e9. Read, not built: the PR is from a fork, so its code does not run on the maintainer's runners, and no local build slot was free.

The fix is right. `fold_warnings_located` keyed `DrillUndersize` at 216, the same key as the shank `AvoidHit` (`216 + part`, the range 216..=220). A group prints one line, so an undersize hole that came first folded a blocking "Do not touch" hit into "repeated on 1 more move" - the pane hid a crash warning. Key 223 is clear of 216..=220, of 221 (`FirstTraverseLow`), and of 222 (reserved for `UndercutLift`, PR #2836), so the two open PRs do not collide. I checked the whole key table: no two arms share a key except the Gouge pair, which is older and told apart by its second element. The pin folds one undersize warning with one avoid hit for each of the five `FixturePart` values and asserts six lines. `Fixes #3040` is in the body, and the decision file is in the PR. `operations.rs` was past 400 lines on main before this PR; the PR adds 21 lines and is not asked to split it here.

One item owed before readiness: a before/after screenshot of the Warnings pane in the body (the project rule for UI PRs). Before: one line with "repeated"; after: the shank hit on its own line.

Verdict: the code is clean; the screenshot is owed. Labels are not changed by this review.
This PR is a draft again. The reason: I push a merge of main with a hand edit (class DELTA) and a new test. Both need a delta review. When the push and the gate are done, I flag the PR ready again.

@sn3ro - I'm refreshing this PR with main for you (you allow maintainer edits, and main is frozen for tonight's release cut, so the refresh holds until it can merge). One conflict in `fold_warnings_located`: main added `UndercutLift` at 217 right next to your `DrillUndersize` line. I kept both, with your 223. Your fix caught a second instance of the same bug: `UndercutLift` at 217 is `AvoidHit` part 1, filed as #3260 (not changed in this PR). I'm building and running your pinning test and clippy now, and will push only if they pass.

One item is still owed from the review: a **before/after screenshot of the Warnings pane** in the PR body (before: one line with "repeated"; after: the shank hit on its own line). Could you add it? That's the last thing between this and merge-ready.

Merged main to resolve conflicts. Head: 9f1f7adb1 (merge of main 2d98d87be).

**The conflict (`crates/ui/src/operations.rs`, `fold_warnings_located`):**

- This PR moves `DrillUndersize` from the key 216 to 223.
- Main added `Warning::UndercutLift` (#1444, commit 5452810e5) with the key 217.
- The merge keeps the two arms. It keeps 223 for `DrillUndersize`.

**The hand edit:** `UndercutLift` gets the key 222, not 217.

- The key 217 is the key of `AvoidHit` with `FixturePart::Holder` (the avoid range is `216 + part`, 216..=220).
- Thus an undercut lift that comes first folds a blocking "Do not touch" hit on the holder into "repeated on 1 more move". This is the same fault as #3040.
- The decision record said that open PR #2836 moves `UndercutLift` to 222. That was not correct: #2836 adds the key 217, as main does. The record now has an addendum.

**New pin:** `operations::warning_fold_tests::an_undercut_lift_never_hides_an_avoid_hit`. It folds one `UndercutLift`, one `DrillUndersize` and one `AvoidHit` for each part, and asserts one line for each.

- With the key 217, the test fails. With 222, it passes.

**Gate on 9f1f7adb1:**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 3 steps (`ui build`, `ui suites: lib`, `ui suites: operations`), 0 failed.
- `warning_fold_tests`: 8 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: none. The diff is in `camcraft-ui` only.

Refresh class: DELTA (a hand edit in the merge). Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Thanks @sn3ro - your refresh landed while ours was still building, and it goes further: `UndercutLift` at 222 with its own pinning test covers #3260 too. Ours is dropped. If you add `Fixes #3260` to the PR body, both close on merge. The before/after screenshot of the Warnings pane is the one item still owed.

Both items are done:

- The PR body ends with `Fixes #3260` after `Fixes #3040`. GitHub now lists the two issues as closed by this PR.
- The PR body has a "Screenshots" section. It shows the status banner before (main: "2 warnings", the two "Do not touch" hits folded) and after (this PR: "4 warnings", one line for each).

The PR branch did not change (head 9f1f7adb1).

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9f1f7adb1a9134789071250c1ea6d2598f001168 -->
Review at head 9f1f7adb1. Verdict: **Needs changes before merge.** The code is correct and the tests pass. One item is still open: the before/after screenshot.

### What looks good

- `DrillUndersize` now has the key 223. `UndercutLift` now has the key 222. Both keys are clear of the `AvoidHit` range (216..=220).
- I read the full key table in the merged tree. No other variants use 222 or 223. The new key 224 for `FirstTraverseUnderTable` (#3081, on main now) does not collide either. `FixtureHit` uses 6..=10, `SweepHit` 200+, `HolderHit` 212+.
- Each of the two pinning tests checks all five `FixturePart` values.
- The decision record is in the PR, and its addendum corrects the earlier note about #2836.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #3040`. The commit subjects are conventional.
- The change is display-only. It does not change posted G-code, the collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. The persisted cache stores each `Warning`, not the fold key.

### Results (local, merged with upstream/main 998c918bb)

Local build. The PR author is not a collaborator, so no runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 3 steps, 0 failed.
  - `ui build (--no-run)`: ok.
  - `ui suites: lib`: 1404 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored. All 8 `warning_fold_tests` pass.
  - `ui suites: operations`: 31 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: none. The diff is in `camcraft-ui` only.
- Extra suites run: none were necessary. The diff does not change `testdata/`, a fixture or golden directory, or any importer code.

### Mutations (run by the reviewer)

1. `DrillUndersize` set back to 216: `a_drill_undersize_never_hides_an_avoid_hit` fails (operations.rs:637). `an_undercut_lift_never_hides_an_avoid_hit` also fails. Result: red, as expected.
2. `UndercutLift` set back to 217: `an_undercut_lift_never_hides_an_avoid_hit` fails (operations.rs:654). The other 7 tests pass. Result: red, as expected.

I restored the code after each mutation. The two pins catch the two faults.

### Requested before merge

1. Add a before/after screenshot of the Warnings pane to the PR body. The earlier review on e81cf16e9 asked for it, and the body does not have it yet. The project rule for a `crates/ui` change requires it.
   - Before: one line with "repeated on 1 more move", and no line for the shank hit.
   - After: the shank hit on its own line.
   - Put the image on a branch of your fork, and link it from the body. Do not add the image to the PR branch.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The PR also fixes #3260 (`UndercutLift` at the key 217). Add `Fixes #3260` to the body. Then the two issues close when the PR merges.
- `crates/ui/src/operations.rs` was above 400 lines on main before this PR. The PR adds 40 lines of tests. A split is not necessary in this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The one open item of the review of `9f1f7adb1` is met: the before/after screenshots are in the body. Before: "2 warnings", with the shank hit folded into the undersize line ("to 10") and the holder hit folded into the undercut line ("to 14"). After: "4 warnings", each "Do not touch" hit on its own line. The head has not changed since that review (code clean, quick gate and clippy green), so the review's request for changes is withdrawn: `needs-rework` -> `merge-ready`. It merges after tonight's release is tagged (nothing merges to main during the cut). Thanks @sn3ro!
